waving at them, making funny faces... and they didn't notice me at all.
What's going on? Jetavie's Chosen One is turning into a ghost!
According to the book, humans with this condition will slowly turn transparent until they completely disappear!
What should we do? Why not ask the all-powerful Jetavie for help?

Title: Antidote
Content:
I've checked. You've been running around for missions lately. That's how your "Ghost Syndrome" started.
When you're too busy and lose your passion for life, things start to slip away from your mind!
Like your soul is leaving your body? That won't do! A ghost can't keep Jetavie company properly.
To help, I made you something. The candy on top has been carefully tailored to your taste.
Promise me, don't turn into a "ghost", and don't let Jetavie become a "ghost" to you, at least not on Jetavie's Birth Date. Okay?
By the way, this "antidote" I'm sending you only treats the symptoms, not the root cause.
The real cure is actually quite simple: just put down that teeth-achingly bitter coffee,
look up, and have a thrilling adventure with the demon lady in front of you!
So, are you ready?

Title: Commandant, Are You Awake?
Content:
Commandant! Are you awake when you receive this email, or are you still resting?
But... even if you're not awake yet, I'm sure the first thing you'll see when you wake up is this mail, so I'll just wait a little longer.
I was going to go find you directly, but the Strike Hawk team reminded me that you've been so busy lately, you might still be resting, so they suggested I send a mail first to greet you.
So, here's the thing! I want to invite you to spend the day with me. As for what we'll do—
How about going shopping? Or we could just go for a walk, I'm up for anything!
Because—today is my activation date! You and the leader have always given me surprise parties on previous activation dates, so I've developed excellent prediction skills. So this time, I decided to ask you out first, to catch you off guard!
How about that? Do you think I "won" this time?
It's a little disappointing though. I wanted to rent out the entire arcade, but the owner wouldn't agree no matter what! Weird.
But that's not the point! As long as I'm with you, anything is the best!
So that's settled, I'll come find you after you reply.

Title: I see!
Content:
Commandant, it turns out you guys—looks like I "lost" again.
No wonder the arcade owner wouldn't let me rent the whole place. It turns out you and the Strike Eagle team had already booked the entire place as a surprise for me today!
It's not that I'm upset... Okay, I admit it, I'm just a little disappointed, just a tiny bit!
I'm really happy that you all care about me so much, I just didn't expect you to beat me to it again.
But anyway! I had a lot of fun at the arcade with everyone today, so today is a perfect day! Thank you, Commandant.
But there's one thing you probably didn't expect. Ta-da, it's this desktop basketball night light! I got it as a prize from a recent arcade event, and now I'm giving it to you!
Use it as a little pre-sleep exercise, it'll help you sleep tight!

Title: Strange Map
Content:
I got your package, and I have to say, this map is strange!
You actually drew this yourself? These squiggly red lines... you call this a treasure map?
I guess I can follow the instructions, but I have a feeling this is another one of your "activation date surprises." You can't fool me this time.
Just so you know, if I find something bizarre at the end, I won't hesitate to "dispose" of it.
Just wait, I'll find the end of this adventure soon enough.

Title: A Weird Guy
Content:
You... what are you thinking about anyway? I'm really curious about how your brain is wired, how you can always come up with such strange ideas.
I'm not saying I hate it, but swapping all the prizes in a claw machine for snacks? And spending a whole day playing with it? Did you just dream this up one night?
I only put up with it because I could see how excited and dedicated you were. Sticking around the machine with you, trying to claw back all those snacks... I was just trying to help you recoup your costs.
So, yeah, let's just say it was a memorable activation date. After all, you'll never find another machine like that anywhere else in the world.
But don't think I'm taking advantage of you. Did you see the package I sent you? I took it from the machine you made. It seemed pretty special, so consider it a thank you for all your hard work. Don't read too much into it, though.
If there are too many snacks and you can't finish them, I'll come over tomorrow to help you out. We can talk more then. You... what are you thinking about anyway? I'm really curious about how your brain is wired, how you can always come up with such strange ideas.

Title: I...
Content:
Somehow the moon last night reminded me of you.
I can't explain the feeling. I've seen countless moonlit nights before, but last night...
Your face and the moonlight appeared in my mind at the same time.
Maybe I've been thinking too much lately.
Human life is fleeting, yet we chase eternal dreams. Land, creatures, love and hate, life and death.
Is there truly anything eternal in this world?
Even the bright moonlight doesn't last forever.
But when I think of you...
I find myself pondering the possibility of making the moonlight eternal.

Title: Meaning of Forever
Content:
The sea of flowers I passed by today reminded me of the orchids from my memories.
When I walked into the heart of those flowers, a gust of wind blew, carrying a fragrant scent. It reminded me of last night's moon again.
Now that I think about it, perhaps "eternity" doesn't refer to any specific thing, but is simply a natural expression.
Since moonlight can't last forever, let's replace it with something else.
I found some stuff in the forest and created this eco-terrarium. It's completely undisturbed by the outside world, always pure.
Is this what you humans call a "paradise"? Now, it belongs to you.
That's what eternity means.
Whether it's sunny or rainy, day or night, this is the unchanging moonlight between us.

Title: A Delayed Letter
Content:
By the time you receive this letter, I'll have flown away with countless treasures, found a hidden paradise to live in, and will never return to Babylonia...
Haha, don't worry... I'm just kidding.
I'm just going on a secret mission that I can't go into detail about, so don't look for me for a while.
Just keep working hard and wait for me to come back to Babylonia.
But, since the activation date is approaching, I assume you've already prepared my gift and are probably worried about not having a recipient.
Keep your gift ready and check the attachment.
WAIT FOR ME.

Title: A Tiny Reward
Content:
I can't believe you actually found this place on your own. You've done remarkably well.
We had a brief meeting between missions, so I didn't have much time to chat. To make up for it, I'll owe you a favor. You can pick anything you want as a reward.
Think carefully about it. You know I don't make promises lightly.
In exchange for this "favor", please cherish the thing I sent you in the last letter.
Why did I give you a whistle? Maybe it's because it always reminds me of fragments of the past, echoes of memories.
Want to know the story behind it? I'll tell you when I finish my mission tonight and come find you.
Have that dish you made last time ready. You wouldn't... disappoint me, would you, Commandant?

Title: Brownie Refuses to Work!
Content:
DI-DI-DI——
Warning: Overwork! The terminal has been running at high intensity for three consecutive days! Brownie's backend program is completely OVERLOADED!
Angry Brownie is protesting! Angry Brownie is blocking all the Commandant's work emails!
Angry Brownie refuses to continue operation! Refuses! Refuses! Refuses!
——————————————————————————————————————————
I just received this. I set up a special alert, so when Brownie has a bug, it will automatically transmit the relevant information back to my terminal.
So, Commandant, what exactly have you done to your terminal and Brownie?
Anyway, don't do anything rash. I'll be there soon.

Title: Brownie Updated
Content:
I got your gift. I was wondering why you were avoiding the activation date topic all day. So that was your surprise.
You have great taste. I really like it.
You're very sweet...
Alright, Brownie has been fully upgraded and will be more obedient—but you better not overwork it like this again, or next time it'll be you crashing, not Brownie.
Speaking of which, that cafe we went to today was pretty nice. The wall decor was beautiful, and the desserts were delicious. I think I'll go back there a few more times.
The food is a bit pricey though. Even though they have occasional promotions like 50% off on the second item, I can't eat that much at once. Too bad...
What do you think of that cafe, Commandant? Coming here from time to time to enjoy some sweet treats can help spark inspiration.
If you want to go to similar places in the future, you can use Brownie to search.
I've added new features to Brownie, like searching for popular cafes, bakeries, and automatically finding promotions, like the 50% off deal I just mentioned...
These features will definitely come in handy, right?

Title: A Good Day
Content:
Things did not go exactly as I planned. The Commercial District was almost completely closed at midnight, but this still turned out to be a day that meant a lot to me.
Sitting with you under the night sky, waiting for the stars to fade, then watching the sunrise together... this Activation Date is one I'll remember for a long time.
You stayed up all night, so get some proper rest when you go back. Don't overestimate your stamina.
By the time you wake up, the package I ordered for you should've arrived. Put it somewhere you'll see itDpreferably next to your terminalDso you never miss any of my messages again.

Title: Act 3 Scene 5

Content:
Whale: I smell the scent of earth. It's a smell I'll never understand.
Traveler: Vegetation and soil! Let me touch them with my own hands.
Whale: But your commander isn't waiting for you on shore.

Whale: How will you begin your search? The land is vast, and it could easily swallow up your small form.

Title: Stronghold Survey Mission
Content:
Good morning, Commandant.
I've received the mission briefing. Commandant Simon's suggestion makes sense. I'm familiar with that outpost. I've stayed there several times while as a traveling merchant.
I'll be ready and waiting at the Gray Raven's lounge.
Try to pick a weapon that's compact and easy to hide—both in shape and sound.

Title: Regarding the Afternoon...
Content:
Good afternoon, Commandant.
I'm really glad we could go on this mission together today. I've attached my finished mission report to this letter.
As for the talk I couldn't finish earlier, you guessed it.
I did visit that abandoned basement not long ago, but of course, I went without telling Commandant Simon.
Resting at outposts in these sketchy areas isn't always safe, so I have "secret bases" hidden away under the ruins near several outposts. 
Since you've discovered it, I'll give you the key. Don't worry, I have a spare. Whether you want to rest or are just looking for me, you're always welcome here.

Title: Where Snowflakes Fall
Content:
Greetings, Honorable Commandant... it's been a while.
If I may be honest, a simple question has been on my mind for a long time: Why do we instinctively reach out to catch falling snow? Last winter, a new recruit in our squad asked me this. It was her first time seeing snow on the surface. My mind filled with trivial things—cold-weather prep, avalanche safety zones... Before I could say anything, she had already hopped into the snow, leaving me standing alone under the eaves, lost in thought.
Time passes quickly, and fate can be cruel. By the following spring, that child died from severe injuries in Siberia. She must have loved the snow, yet never lived to see another season where she could dance among it. At her funeral, that same question returned to me: Why do we reach out to catch snowflakes without thinking? When the priest closed her casket, I felt as if I were the one lying inside—my vision fading, never again able to see the pure white world I once took for granted... never again able to see your back in uniform.
Honorable Commandant, I wonder, does snow fall outside your window at this very moment? I believe... I've finally found the answer to that question, and it's one I wish to share with you.

Title: Envisioning a Harbor
Content:
To let pure white snowflakes fall into our palms, to help a wandering soul find a place to rest... perhaps that's why we instinctively reach out our hands.
I once imagined that someday I would find my own home, not in the Purifying Force, not in Babylonia... but on the surface, in a house where I could feel the change of seasons. There would be flowers, a fireplace, and you, my dearest Commandant.
But in this age, dreams often feel too far away, so I had to make mine smaller. Maybe... a tiny house? I became really focused on it, but when I actually started building, I found it was much harder than I thought. The work kept getting interrupted by missions, and the parts scattered every time I traveled between the ground and sky. Then, one summer, after I had almost finished, a heavy rain ruined the little house... it collapsed from the moisture.
Afterward, I picked up the scattered pieces and put them together little by little. Life wasn't easy, but having the house gave me something to hold onto... What color should I plant on the windowsill? Would the garden path be too narrow for two people to walk hand in hand? How high should the coat rack be for your jacket? What kind of armchair would you like to nap in? These small worries brought me profound happiness.
The seasons passed, and winter came again. When I placed the last tile on the roof and sent it with this letter, I realized nearly a year had passed. Commandant, life is too long... but also too short—just the time it takes for a snowflake to fall. I think... only by carefully holding onto these moments can we make them last. Though this dream still feels far away, I wait and hope for the day when you and I can be together in the home that belongs to us.
P.S. The weather is getting colder. Please keep warm during your surface missions and take care of yourself.

November 21
Your dear Bianca

Title: Today's Schedule
Content: Good morning, Commandant. Today's the day we planned to pick out fabric for your new outfit.\nTo make sure you'd have time, I went through your schedule last week, one task at a time. I coordinated with each department in advance and rescheduled anything that might overlap. So you can relax and enjoy the day without worry. I'm looking forward to finalizing your new casual design together.\nI'm waiting for you in the corridor of the Commercial District.

Title: Look Forward to the Finished Outfit
Content:
Thank you, Commandant.
The designer shops you took me to were wonderful. I learned how each of them chooses fabric, plans their cuts, and works with a needle and thread.
The one who left the deepest impression on me was the children's clothing designer. I thought those lively, cheerful clothes must have come from someone with a bright childhood and a playful heart. But after talking, I found the designer's story was much like mine.
Both of us were abandoned as children. Both had to fight to survive. And both finally stand here today because of the kindness and love of others.
"My designs don't come from longing for the past. I design to make the present shine even brighter."
A designer's experience is just a foundation. What really matters is understanding what clothes mean to time—to the moments and occasions they are part of.
Designing clothes is, in a way, thinking about how to make each moment more beautiful.
...
After cutting the birth date cake and saying goodbye to you, I went back and scrapped all my earlier sketches. I decided to focus on everyday life instead. And before I knew it, a design I truly liked appeared on the page.
I want to keep the surprise, so I can't tell you yet what kind of outfit I made. But as a small thank-you, I used some leftover material to make a simple raven doll with clothes you can change.
It's still plain for now, but its wardrobe will grow as our story continues. I hope it can carry our shared memories.

Title: Come Spend Time with Bambinata?
Content:
Commandant, Bambinata marked down her Activation Date for this year very early, so Bambinata won't get it wrong.
This year, on Bambinata's Activation Date, Bambinata has daily missions at the conservation area. They said there are many children here who need companions their "own age," so they asked Bambinata to try out missions here.
Although Bambinata isn't sure if this is the right thing to do, Bambinata has worked hard to learn the children's games. They teach Bambinata how to play over and over, say Bambinata's dance is beautiful, and even bring flowers they find at the conservation area. The supervisor praised Bambinata that day. Commandant, Bambinata will keep trying her best.
Bambinata's Activation Date happens to be the same day as the conservation area's anniversary. The supervisor said they will hold a celebration, and if Bambinata wants, she can perform a dance on stage that day.
You once said that on Bambinata's Activation Date, Bambinata can do whatever she wants. Commandant, Bambinata's wish is to have you watch her dance. Will you come and spend time with Bambinata?

Title: Bambinata Is Happy
Content:
Bambinata thought she just wanted the Commandant to watch her dance from the audience, and then experience other activities at the celebration together.
Bambinata didn't expect the audience to cheer so loudly, asking Bambinata to keep performing. This made Bambinata a little unsure... But then the Commandant came on stage and took Bambinata's hand... Only then did Bambinata feel at ease and know how to continue her dance.
Even though Bambinata had never practiced dancing with the Commandant before, when dancing together, Bambinata seemed to instantly know how to follow the Commandant's lead. It felt magical to Bambinata. Hearing the audience cheer made Bambinata happy. Commandant, do you feel the same way?
Bambinata saved the photo data of her dancing with the Commandant and stored it in this swan-shaped mini projector. Since Bambinata and Commandant danced a swan-themed dance together, Bambinata specifically chose this design.
Bambinata has watched it many times already. Bambinata really likes it and hopes the Commandant will too... For Bambinata, these are the most precious memories.

Title: Good Morning!
Content:
Good morning, Commandant! Did you sleep well?
Today's schedule is quite packed. First, we'll stop by the camera shop to pick up the one we sent for repair. Then, at noon, we'll visit the museum to see the limited medieval art exhibition. After that, we'll go to a cafe for some chestnut cake and talk about what we saw at the museum...
I've been planning this Activation Date holiday for a long time. I wanted it to be fun, relaxed, and full of delights. Get ready for a busy but happy day!
Oh, and make sure to wear your best outfit! I have a surprise for you, and I want to give it to you in person. What is it? I won't say yet. That would spoil the fun.
So it's settled then. Meet me at the entrance of the Commercial District. Don't be late!

Title: So Many Photos!
Content:
I had such a wonderful day... We finally saw that restored painting, had delicious chestnut cake at the cafe, and took so many photos together at the art gallery. Ayla feels fully recharged now! Completely satisfied! I can't imagine a more perfect day than this.
But don't worry, Commandant. Even though I got carried away having fun, I didn't forget the surprise I promised you.
Do you remember when we were at the cafe, and I kept asking you to stand where the sunlight was brightest while I took your picture?
Here's the reason—ta-da! I wanted to take a real photo on silver halide film.
Remember our promise in Constellia? From now on, I'll record each of our days together in a way you can actually see and touch. That's why I chose today, my Activation Date, as the start of that promise.
When I pressed the shutter, the light passed through the lens and struck the film's silver layer, capturing that moment. Every tiny grain on the film holds a trace of sunlight from that afternoon.
Commandant, do you think that makes this film a little time capsule?
I picked my favorite photo and sent it to you with this letter.
I hope that every time you see it on your desk, you'll think of that afternoon we spent together.
No matter when or where you are, as long as you think of me, I'll be right by your side.

Title: Greetings
Content:
How curious. I asked Billie to retrieve a childhood toy of mine from the abandoned Las Prados, but through some strange twist of fate, it ended up at your doorstep instead. By the time I realized the delivery was misrouted, you had already taken the time to fully assemble it...
To avoid misunderstanding, let me be clear: I do not blame you in the slightest. I'm simply surprised you would spend so much time on a toy that is both needlessly difficult and utterly pointless.
This snow globe was a birthday gift from long ago. Perhaps the giver hoped I would develop some sentimental attachment—a "sense of belonging to Las Prados," or something similarly trivial. Ironically, she never once gave me the quiet, leisurely time needed to put this strange little toy together.
Still, I must thank you. You completed this time capsule from my past and helped me sever a meaningless bond. And now, I no longer need this toy to reminisce about the place where I grew up. If you don't mind, please keep this "Las Prados" by your side.
As for me, I've already set out for distant places... But after our brief encounter, you will catch up to me again, won't you?

Title: Take a Detour, Maybe?
Content:
Hello, Commandant.
I can't believe how quickly time has passed—this day has come around again already.
As you know, I've been busy with New Sophiasburgh affairs lately, so I haven't been in touch. Luckily, I heard you'd be coming to the Arctic for field duty today.
I'm not sure what the mission is, but let me join you. It'll be a perfect chance to catch up and talk about everything that's happened recently.
(Everyone said to keep it a surprise, but I think it's better to talk about it in advance. After the mission, we may need to take a detour to a newly built port. They said there are some "festival gifts" waiting to be brought back to New Sophiasburgh.)

Title: This Is a Lucky Star
Content:
Talk about bad luck...
Who knew picking up gifts could lead to a series of mishaps? First, the delivery hadn't arrived, so I ended up playing snowball fights with the local kids. Then someone using a snowplow to make snowballs accidentally scraped the delivery boat, tipping it over and scattering the cargo everywhere.
And then, while we chased after one of the Christmas trees, the ice suddenly cracked and a rapid current swept us away. We drifted on a small floating chunk of ice all the way into the middle of the frozen sea, with no idea where we were—so until rescue arrived, we could only sit close together on that little patch of ice and talk about what's been happening lately to pass the time.
Now that I think about it, maybe it wasn't all that bad. Awkward, yes, but I still got to talk with you about everything. And paddling with leftover Christmas tree branches when rescue felt too slow, that was actually fun.
So I guess being with you really does make things turn out better. My instincts were right.
Unfortunately, by the time rescue arrived, it was already late, so I couldn't take you to see the area around New Sophiasburgh. We'll save that for next time.
Speaking of which, I only just found out that one of the gifts I was supposed to pick up was meant for you. But for obvious reasons, it's now at the bottom of the sea. I don't know if this can replace it, but I've sent you the star-shaped gem that was hanging on the Christmas tree. I heard it was made from "ancient ice"... which I assume means it lasts a very long time?

Title: Ancient "Mystery"
Content:
Good morning, Gray Raven. I'm guessing you have a bit of free time today. Take a walk with me—there's something interesting I'd like to show you.
Are you interested in ancient civilizations? While reading a recent report from WGAA, I learned they discovered a civilization that mysteriously vanished thousands of years ago. All of its totems and sculptures depict a bronze-colored little bird.
I imagine it might have once been a fantastical kingdom populated entirely by "little birds"—hundreds upon thousands of them, working tirelessly until their "nest" grew into a vast civilization...
But at present, there's no way to verify my theory. All we know is that their homeland lies buried underground, sealed in the "amber" of time.
This archaeological discovery fascinates me. WGAA has even organized a reconstruction exhibition based on it. Would you be willing to visit it with me?
...And if you could share your theories and guesses with me while we explore, I would be most delighted.

Title: The Charm of Imagination
Content:
Thank you for taking me to see the "ancient outfits" displayed in the reconstruction exhibit. They were fascinating. Even though they were modern recreations, wandering beside you through the restored holographic scenes made me feel as though I had stepped back into history.
I loved the ideas you shared with me. Your words opened a doorway in my mind—a doorway to a possibility I had never imagined.
Once a piece of history has disappeared, there is no single right answer to what really happened. Even if we try our best to restore the truth, all we find are small fragments left behind by time. No one can fully define the past. All we can do is gather these pieces and create new stories together with the people beside us.
So I used my own way to give shape to the "imagination" in my mind and placed it in your hands.
We crossed this little river of time together today. As my companion in that moment, I hope you'll share more of your thoughts about the gift. I'll be waiting for your reply.

Title: Ta-da! Nanami's Super Cool Custom Gear!
Content:
Did you get my gift, Commandant? Did you? Did you? Did you? Did you?
Pretty cool, right? I spent forever making this super powerful armor, based on that really fun game and my favorite style!
To craft it, I dug through piles of materials, including mysterious super alloys and weird stuff that looks like dragon scales.
Anyway, wearing it boosts defense by a ton! It's totally a golden legendary item!
I named it "Super Dragonroar"! Cool name, right? If we both wear armor like this, we'll be the ultimate hunting duo!
Oh, and tonight, you have to wear this armor and play games with me! Hehe.

Title: Beep Beep! Hunt Success!
Content:
I'm so happy today!
Everyone at the church held a celebration for me and Haicma, and there was so much good food. But somehow it turned into a wrestling match! And guess what, Lazer won!
And in tonight's co-op hunt, your moves were amazing, Commandant!
We were completely in sync! Every bit of support from you was perfectly timed, and that stylish teamwork skill—wow!
Our coordination must have gone past 100%... it HAS to be at 170% by now!
It must be because you were wearing my custom gear! Hmph! I am just THAT awesome!
With everyone around me... I feel so, so happy...
You should be happy every day too, Commandant!
And if you're ever not happy, I'll swoop in at light speed and chase every bit of "unhappiness" away!

Title: Subject: Greetings and Return Gift
Content:
It has been some time, Commandant.
I have received your gift. You were the first to send me well-wishes today.
There is something rather amusing that I would like to share with you.
This morning, I discovered that everyone in the church was secretly preparing a ceremony without letting Nanami or me know. After investigating, I learned it was a birthday celebration.
It seems Zavier found out that you send messages and gifts to Nanami and me every year on this day, so he wanted to prepare a special surprise.
Also, following your suggestion, I've continued using painting as a way to record what I observe.
Yesterday, as part of my daily routine, I practiced painting in a nearby valley. I painted the flowers there onto a bookmark and made it into a small artwork. I hope you'll find use for it.
Based on an analysis of the colors, I estimate it can help reduce human visual fatigue.

Additionally, your monthly medical report shows you are in good health. I recommend maintaining this condition.

Title: Subject: Digital Version Sent as Attachment
Content:
My apologies.
When I sent you the physical bookmark artwork earlier, I didn't consider that you might be reading digital books and documents instead.
So I redrew the bookmark digitally from memory and turned it into a simple program you can use as a third-party electronic bookmark.
You can send feedback after trying it. If the image displays incorrectly or if there are other bugs, I can provide a corrected version within half an hour.
I'm also working on a new digital "Starry Valley" bookmark—replacing the sunlight parameters with the actual star chart from your birthday. It will serve as a night-reading version, and once it's finished, it will automatically update your terminal wallpaper.

Attachment: [Haicma's Bookmark Art.exe]

Title: Long Overdue
Content:
It's been a long time since our last letter. I hope you've been well.
The reconstruction of Kowloong is finally nearing its end. The displaced people are no longer hungry or cold, and for the first time in ages, I've returned to the observation platform to enjoy a brief moment of peace.
Yet the moment I stepped onto the platform—despite the wind howling, children crying, adults laughing—everything felt strangely distant, as if the noise couldn't reach me. Walking alone across the high platform, the sky suddenly felt too wide, and the space around me felt too empty. This past year has been nothing but rushing from one matter to the next; even my bed is buried under the city's endless affairs. News about you only reaches me occasionally, and only in fragments from others.
The seasons have turned once more... As the ruler of Kowloong, another year of history has settled onto my shoulders. Tonight, to celebrate our city rising from the ruins, the people will release prayer lanterns into the sky. The observation platform will be filled with light. I write to you for no other reason than this—if you are free today, would you come and share this moment with me?

Title: Year After Year
Content:
What do you think? Does the sky full of glowing lights please you?
Prayer lanterns are Kowloong's local handmade craft—paper shells, simple frames, and a small wick. When I was young, I wrote wishes on them with my brothers, lit the flame, and waited for the lanterns to rise into the night. After I became ruler, I no longer had the luxury to enjoy moments like that. Releasing a lantern with you tonight... it almost felt like reclaiming a warmth I've long missed.
I had someone bring one over, and I painted the peacock patterns on it myself. I'm sending it to you with this letter. If you have a wish someday, write it on the lantern and let it fly, just like everyone else. Our paths may lead us far apart, but in the end, we still share the same sky.
May every light in every home shine on this land for generations to come. No matter what trials await us, Kowloong's story will endure. When the storm finally clears, come find me again, Commandant of Gray Raven.

Title: Repair Grassland
Content:
Today I saw someone amazing on the terminal.
In the video, someone used this tiny tool to poke the lawn, and the damaged patch instantly turned healthy again. So I thought, if you keep doing that, could you turn all the little turf pieces we brought back from the surface into a whole grassland? I asked the captain to order it as an Activation Date gift.
But I'm not sure if I'm using it wrong. No matter how I poke the grass, it won't grow back, and I even made it worse by accident... So frustrating...
So I'm sending this tool over to you, Commandant. Maybe you can figure out how it actually works.

Title: Create Grassland
Content:
So it turns out turf really can be rolled up, just like in the videos. And it turns out you're the one with real grass-growing magic.
While I was out looking for you, you secretly transformed the empty space behind the lounge into a whole lawn, and even fixed the little piece of grass I ruined. Now I can roll around there whenever I like. I love the smell of damp grass and fresh soil.
But rolling in the grass means lots of bits will stick to my fur. The captain is definitely going to comment on that.
Which means... the fur-cleaning duties from now on go to you, Commandant.

Title: Hell Mode Challenge
Content:
Hi, Commandant. Things have been hectic lately, so it wasn't easy to secure time off for my Activation Date. I just finished the annual maintenance on my powered arms. Oh, and you remember our plans for today, right? Just in case, I'm sending the booking details again.
Time: 13:30, 02/10/2026
Location: Ingenious Workshop
Package: Two-Person Music Box Crafting, Ultimate Difficulty (shop note: not beginner-friendly, it's really hard!)
Jumping straight into the hardest option might be a bit reckless, but with you there, Commandant, I know we can pull it off.
I've always wanted to make a music box with my own hands. To me, music boxes hold so many precious memories from my younger days, and I want to record the present and the future I share with you inside one as well.
Anyway, I'll see you at the workshop entrance. Don't be late!

Title: Eight Notes or Seven?
Content:
Commandant, are you back at the dorm yet? I still can't believe how chaotic today turned out. First I opened the wrong welding valve and drove the connector straight into the workbench. Then I forgot the welding order and only remembered the sound cylinder after the box was already assembled. And when we were putting the cylinder together, I used too much adhesive, so the core stuck and wouldn't make a sound.
Basically, something went wrong at every step. Thankfully, you came to my rescue at the end and thought of using the high-temperature welding torch to melt the excess glue around the cylinder. Otherwise, we would've gone home with nothing to show for it. If Yata had tried to help, the box probably would've been flattened in one go and turned into a metal puck.
I've attached the music box we made together to this message. Because of all those mishaps, it can only play seven notes, but the crackling, uneven melody is kind of charming in its own way. I've always wanted to give you something truly special, and it looks like I finally managed it today... Please make sure to listen to the fourth track on the music box.
Oh, and are your fingers really okay? Even with protective gear, working around high-temperature machinery can still leave a burning sensation. I went to get some cooling patches. Wait for me in the lounge for a bit.

Title: Sea & Sky Express
Content:
Your cash-on-delivery parcel has arrived. Please pick it up and settle payment at the designated Babylonia station. Previous pickup point is temporarily closed due to logistics issues. Apologies for the trouble... 
That should do for the cover text, right? Hopefully enough to slip past your terminal's scan filters...It's kind of a hassle to send you a message like this, and honestly, it's not anything urgent... 
It's just... well...The conservation area where we went fishing is holding a Harvest Festival today. It's packed with people, and the whole coastline is beautifully decorated! Even the reef where we sat got roped off as part of the setup.
The food stalls are great too, though it's a bit too crowded. I snuck into the prep area and managed to grab some early samples... so... um... yeah...So... are you coming? 
Ah! No pressure. If you're busy, that's totally fine. Next time, then! If something fun happens again, I'll let you know.

Title: Letter of Thanks
Content:
Thanks for inviting me to run the general store in the conservation area. I'm really grateful, but sadly, I can't take the job due to health reasons. Still, thank you for recommending me. I really do love the coastline here...
Oh! Don't worry, I'm not actually unwell—that was just for the review board. Honestly, your offer was really tempting.
Staying undercover, running a small seaside shop, grilling food for the locals, heading out early and back late with the kids... and spacing out by the ocean in between. 
....Just thinking about it makes me want to go for it.But... I'm not quite the same person I used to be. Still haven't kicked my slacking habits, though...But really, you've given me a lot of courage. 
If I get the chance, I'll come visit this place more often.Lastly... thank you.Thanks for coming to the Harvest Festival.And thank you for remembering my Activation Date.

Title: Just Confirm
Content:
Commandant, I know you're most likely still out on a mission, and communications probably aren't stable. I don't even know if you'll see this message...
It's not like I'm expecting much anyway.
Still, by routine, you were supposed to send in a check-in last night. There's been nothing so far, so Command has marked you as "Awaiting Signal Recovery" again.
I've confirmed your life signs are normal, but did you wander into another signal-blocked zone, or run into yet another technical issue? Losing track of you all the time like this is... really irritating.
Ahem. Anyway. Looking at my schedule, today is just an ordinary day. Aside from the system reminding me I can claim a congratulatory gift through my personal file, there's also... well... the fact that someone who claims to have an excellent memory went ahead and booked a restaurant, and even invited me to dinner tonight. That part is just a little... slightly special.
Only slightly, okay.
I'm not rushing you, and I'm definitely not worried about whether the restaurant's limited desserts sell out. As the Engineering Force captain, I'm simply monitoring the frontline Commandant's mission progress and safety. The Gray Raven Commandant is a decorated hero of humanity, after all. Caring about your safety is... well... part of my job.
...Anyway, if you do make it back on schedule today...
Be on time. If you're late, I'm ordering without you. Being the Commandant doesn't give you special treatment.
So... come back safe.

Title: Just Thanks
Content:
...Dinner tonight was actually pretty good.
Do you have any idea how startled I was when you suddenly showed up like that? But, considering you were thoughtful enough to bring handmade treats...
I'll call it even, Commandant.
Next time, don't bring back anything that sweet. And definitely don't rush into some communication-dead conservation area just because you heard about a tasty dessert. Even if it's for a gift.
Ahem... since you did bring something back, I guess I can't just pretend it didn't happen. Here. Take this.
No scanning. No taking it apart. And absolutely no asking why it looks like a globe.
It's a dual-coordinate positioning terminal. I made it while waiting for you today. Uses military signals, nothing complicated.
Press the switch, and the two lights that come on show where each of us is. Between them, it plots the shortest safe route.
In theory, no matter what remote, desolate corner you run off to while doing something heroic or reckless, we won't lose track of each other anymore.
I built it while waiting, so it's just an engineering prototype. I gave it to you because you make a perfect test subject—and because my Activation Date turned out pretty nice, so I felt like saying thanks.
Anyway, it's not some cheesy "I want to always know where you are" thing or anything like that...

Title: Always Be by Your Side
Content:
Commandant, are you awake yet?
Right now, I'm walking back from the Commercial District toward the lounge.
To be honest, even though I thought I had prepared everything we might need ahead of time, when the time came, I still felt like it wasn't quite enough.
So I took a chance and went to the Commercial District. Luckily, a few shops were still open.
Just as I finished picking out supplies and was about to leave, the shopkeeper called me back. He took a few handmade origami pieces from the counter and told me to choose some. He said they were folded by his daughter, and he wanted to give them to customers on such a special day.
I picked four to bring back and share with everyone. I chose a little four-leaf clover for myself. Want to guess what I picked for the others, Commandant?
The artificial sky will brighten soon, and the distant horizon is already starting to glow. I can faintly hear the sound of fireworks from the nearby residential area.
May... the very first morning light arrive before you wake, gently melting away all of last night's weariness.
Another year has passed, Commandant. I'll be spending this new year with you, too.
And... I'll always be here by your side. Always.

Title: Sleep a Little Longer
Content:
Are you looking at the clear sky outside your window too, Commandant?
Though I really hope you're still resting right now. On such a precious day off, sleeping in would be lovely, wouldn't it?
Last night's dinner was warmer and livelier than I ever imagined. It feels like it's been so long since we had such peaceful, slow days. And you, Commandant, you looked really happy last night.
While sorting through documents today, I found an old fairy tale book tucked away on the bookshelf. I remember we picked it together that day at the bookstore.
It's about a child guarding a little spark, guiding lost travelers through an endless night. Rereading it now, it feels like... we've become just like the child in the story.
I used to worry I wasn't strong or steady enough, but every battle we've faced, every reunion we've shared... they've all shown me something. Maybe what we call a "fairy tale" is simply believing that our hearts can light up even paths that seem impossible.
About the future... I have just this one simple wish. I want to stay by your side through all that lies ahead, and I also wish to see your smile in all our little, everyday moments of joy.
The road may still be long, but... will you let me keep walking it with you?

Title: One Hour Until the Scheduled Photoshoot
Content:
Good afternoon, Commandant.
Just a reminder: our scheduled photoshoot is in one hour.
I've prepared a new blue suit for you and laid it out in the lounge.
I picked it up in the Commercial District yesterday, thinking that you would need something sharp for today. You arranged gifts for everyone else, but didn't leave anything else for yourself...
Once Gray Raven's group photo is done, we have the afternoon free. I've taken the liberty of scouting a few locations on the commercial street.
Our first stop will be a cafe with some decent afternoon tea options. Knowing you, you probably had a rushed lunch again.
After that, perhaps we can visit the cinema...
Actually, never mind the strict plan. I know you prefer to keep things flexible.
But at least allow me to handle dinner. I've reserved a table at a restaurant with a pleasant atmosphere.
And please do come to the studio on time. We shouldn't miss this annual tradition. I'll see you there.

Title: Good morning, Commandant.
Content:
Dear Commandant,
I hope this mail doesn't disturb you since the time here might differ slightly from Babylonia's standard. I know today is your day off, if you've already freshened up, please find me outside your room.
The WGAA's maintenance staff just gave me a key to a castle.
This castle seems to predate the Golden Age. The WGAA had all renovations completed last month... So it's now open for visiting.
Today's weather is... impeccable. My month-long preparations have paid off. Based on our strolling pace, we shall reach the castle's top room just as the sun rises over the bay.
I can't think of anything more worth sharing with you today.
...Of course, if you wish to sleep in a bit longer, it's alright for us to head out later.
To me, you're the brightest part of this morning.

Title: Good night
Content:
Dear Commandant,
I admit that when we were sitting by the fireplace chatting, your warmth made me realize how much more I wanted to say.
But I faltered every time our eyes met. I hope that if you're reading this mail, you'll sense my true feelings I failed to express.
You said you liked the sound of firewood crackling in the hearth. There was a time when I used to fall asleep to that sound, when tomorrow was a thing I dared not hope for. But because of you, I've grown accustomed to believing in hope.
I'm also thinking about everything we've been through together.
I can't imagine who I'd be if we had never met.
I wish to repay what you've done for me, but I could never find the right moment. Now, I think I'm ready to give you this... This is a talisman from long ago, a symbol of the crescent moon and renewal. Please keep lending me your light, so we can drive away the darkness even in the night.
I wish you sweet dreams, Commandant, and may the nights we spend together from now on be a little longer.
Good night, Commander.

Title: Bambinata has a favor to ask...
Content:
Commandant, Bambinata learned from the terminal's data that Activation Day is a celebration of one's birth with their "cherished ones."
As per Bambinata's notebook, a year ago today, it was Commandant whom Bambinata shared "happiness" with.
...Commandant, Bambinata wants to spend this year's Activation Day with you too.
Bambinata heard the amusement park in the shopping district has many exciting rides. If your time allows, Bambinata'd like to go there with you.
Bambinata'll be waiting for your reply.

Title: Commemorative Gift
Content:
Bambinata had so much fun today, Commandant.
The ice cream, the balloons... Everything at the amusement park was a delight to Bambinata.
But out of everything, the carousel was the best. It felt like time slowed down when Bambinata was on the pony, with you smiling beside Bambinata. Did you feel the same as Bambinata did?
Bambinata bought a pair of crystal music balls from a souvenir shop. Bambinata'd like you to keep one. Bambinata hope it'll remind you of every moment we shared today.
Bambinata placed the other one in the most noticeable spot in the lounge. Everything we experienced today will be kept in Bambinata's heart forever.
Thank you, Commandant, for making this Activation Day so wonderful.

Title: See Ya Later in the Residential District
Content:
Commandant!!! Are you up already?
If you are, please hop back into bed! I want to see your sleeping face up close and wake you up like they do in dramas!
Nah, just kidding!
Get back on track, didn't we promise a sketching date at the coastal forest on the surface today? I'm heading to the residential district to grab some supplies.
Drawing tools, camera gear, and outing essentials are all set. I'm bringing a moisture-proof mat too, and insect repellent for you...
Just let me know if you need anything else!
Oh, and a little heads-up that I've prepared a special gift for you, but you'll have to wait until we're on the surface!
I'll see you soon, Commandant!

Title: My Gift Got Eaten...
Content:
Nooooooooooo!!! Commandant, your gift...
Got eaten...
I wanted to make you a painting with sugar-coated paper and edible pigments, but right after I finished it, a group of cubs popped out of nowhere and snatched it away!
Now most of it's already in their tummies...
Well, it's my Activation Day, so I'll let them slide this once.
At least it was kind of cute when one of them got green pigments on its nose when munching my painting!
Though this gift is gone, I've got another idea!
I'm going to make a leaf craft for you! Sounds fun, right?
Hmm... Commander, can you hear it? The sound of the waves carried on the wind.
I'll be back at the campsite once it's done. Then, let's hit the beach together!

Title: Jingle Bell
Content:
[The apple-shaped countdown clock rings. A note comes out from the bottom.]
Dear Babylonia Commandant,
Sorry to have disturbed you. I didn't expect to be able to meet you again. It turns out we are bound by destiny, right?
However, judging from our current special relationship, a little more joint effort is still required to create a face-to-face opportunity for us to exchange our feelings.
To celebrate this, I've prepared a 'surprise' for you and your companions on the top floor of the bell tower around the conservation area which will only appear at 12 o'clock midnight.
Let me tell you a secret—I will check if our little Commandant has collected it or not. Don't let me down.

Title: Mistletoe Bush
Content:
[A mistletoe bush falls down from the top of the bell tower before the last toll of the bell. There's a letter and a table knife hidden in it.]
"Thump──" Dear little Commandant, I hope you came here alone, otherwise our relationship would be exposed.
Did I cause any trouble to the event that you're gonna hold in the conservation area? The campfire, the colorful light strips, and the delicacies you brought there... What a lively, warm scene! How I wish I could be a part of it, especially as a── Ah, just kidding... Feeling nervous already?
This table knife was produced at the place where we first met. I used it to taste many foods. However, you are more delicious than those foods.
I wonder at what kind of perfect moment should I enjoy "you"...
Sigh. The waiting before the feast is always hard, but I'll just regard it as my Christmas wish. You will fulfill it for me, right?
Happy holiday as well, my dear little Com-man-dant.

Title: Wanna Have a Look Over Here?
Content:
I have finished my mission at the Arctic Route Union and have two days off.
Now I'm in the cabin where I grew up. I spent my childhood here with grandpa.
The cabin has been deserted for a long time, but the items here seem to be in good shape.
On the door pillar are marks grandpa made to trace my height every year when I was little.
Now I realize that the steps that seemed high when I was little are actually just fine.

I heard you just completed your mission around here. Wanna have a look over here? I've prepared a gift for you.
Here are the coordinates in case you want to come...

Title: Happy Today
Content:
Did you have some rest?
I had fun today. Actually, I didn't expect that you would come and even with a gift.
I wonder if you like the handbow.
I made it under grandpa's guidance. With that said, all I did was putting the components I bought together.
I replaced many parts of it after that, but is it still the original handbow?

Every time when I hold it in my hand, it reminds me of the old days. Now I give it to you as a gift. Hope it can remind you of me every time you see it.

Title: Activation Date Invitation
Content:
January 1st. The first day of a year.
I love days with special meanings like this, making time meaningful and memorable. So... It also happens to be my 'Activation Date.'
It's my start and our start as well.
Anyway, come for a drink tonight.
To celebrate January 1st and to celebrate...
my 'Activation Date.'

Title: A Gift for You
Content:
The Activation Date gift you brought me is good. I'll take good care of it. But you left in a hurry and forgot to take my gift to you... I thought it might rain later, so I mailed it to you to save you the trouble of coming back.
I made it myself. Sometimes I note interesting things down when I see them... Well, just regard it as a model, like the popular crystal ball toy in the Golden Age with shiny sparkles, upside-down snowflakes, and dreams.
As if what dream this 'world' holds... that is another story. It requires extra 'money.'
PS: Please put the cube sugar in the box to the pantry area in your lounge. I hope I can see it next time when I visit you. Thank you.

Title: Nanami, the Stargazer!
Content:
Hello, hello! This is Nanami speaking!
I'm working on something that requires extreme dedication, so I have to leave you this voice mail.
Do you still remember, Commandant? That I want to take the photo of the most beautiful photo of the stars in the world as a New Year gift for you!
However, the stars have been hiding behind the clouds these days... Did Grandma Earth run into something unpleasant?
Anyway, I have to keep my promise. I will find a place above all the clouders for Commandant!
So I climbed, up to the tall snow mountain. But a snowstorm started halfway, and the snow soon reached my knees.
When it stopped, there was not enough time for me to reach the top...
Just when I started to feel sad, the sky opened. More surprisingly, there is a large, clear lake!
Haha, this way I can take a photo of the reflection of the stars on the lake! It's gonna be amazing!
Just look forward to it, Commandant! Over!

Title: Among the Stars...
Content:
Beep beep beep—! I've captured the MOST beautiful stars!
It's so crowded. Numerous stars in one small photo together.
They seem to shine bright just a few centimeters away from one another but are actually thousands of light years apart...
Thinking about this, I start to follow Babylonia with the telescope unconsciously.
What are you doing somewhere near Earth, Commandant?
The galaxy is big, while Nanami is small.
We are so tiny compared to the stars, but perhaps this is why we get to stay together so closely.
I have to share with you the feeling that the twinkling stars gave me.
Admire the stars with me if there is a chance, Commandant. I will be waiting for you!

Title: Title Here
Content:
Greetings, Commandant.
I acquired the expression on a book from Kowloong. Hope I used it correctly.
Days ago, I came across a long deserted library.
In it, I found a book named Proof: The So-Called Soul. According to HAIpedia (a cold jest here. HAIpedia is Haicma), it's a book published in the Golden Age. The author used philosophy to explore the possibility of AI producing souls.
After I finished it, I noticed a 4.36% deviation in my emotion circuit. I guess it's a bit like... having an empty fridge when you are hungry at night.
I have already mailed the book to you. Hope you can read it, so we can discuss about it later.

Btw, you haven't sent me your monthly medical examination report. Please sync it as soon as possible.

Title: A soul?
Content:
Thank you for your letter.
According to the logistics information, you have already received the book..
In your letter, you mentioned "Robots don't have to be the copy of humans because the latter is not perfect."
It made my body temperature go up by 2.6 ℃ and core operation speed by 17%. Is his the so-called 'happiness?'
At the end of the book, the author thinks that "thinking machines" are a miracle just like "the birth of human consciousness."
Do you agree with this?
Or do you think that I have a soul?

Btw, I have received your medical examination report. According to the data analysis, you need to work less and rest more.

Title: Letter Received
Content:
Thank you for your letter.
How time flies. The New Year has arrived in a blink of an eye.
The city is getting busy with all the lanterns and crowds on the streets. The festive vibe is getting stronger.
I'm available today. And if you happen to have time, I suggest we take a walk together down the Kowloong streets while we chat about what happened these days.

I wanted to welcome you, but it's my birthday today. I'm afraid it would attract too much attention.
Why don't we keep low key and enjoy some quiet time together?

Title: Past and Present
Content:
Not long after we said goodbye, I came across a kite crafting store on the street.
The owner grandma thought I was a traveler, explaining the origin of kites and related old traditions nonstop.
I listened carefully, which made her even more excited and shared with me how a kite is made.
Blue kites are auspicious. I made one as a gift for you and hope it will bring good luck to you.
Although it's small, every thread and texture on it is a mark of time.
And this is only one of the numerous Kowloong traditional craft techniques.
The past and the present meet. The history and the mind intertwine. Everything lasts to this day and still shines bright.
I wish I could tell you everything, but I'm afraid that there isn't enough space to go into details.
Just visit Kowloong if you're curious. I will tell you everything about the traditions that passed through generations.

Title: Come and Play with No. 21
Content: Captain asked me to have some rest today. But staying alone is boring. So come and play with me, Commandant.\nI came across an amazing place with many humans about my height, man-eating snakes flying in the sky, zebras running in a circle, and colorful balloons... I'm interested in them, but according to the manager there, I'm only allowed to enter in the company of a human. So I want you to investigate that place with me.\nI hate typing. I'm on my way to you.

Title: Come and Play with No. 21
Content:
I love this "amusement park" place.
I can chase after pigeons and reach the sky in a sky wheel. It feels so relaxing everywhere.
Commandant won the balloon shooting championship. I won a "wolf buddy," and I'm glad that it smells like Commandant. I feel comfortable holding it in my arms.
It's a shame that we didn't get on the flying snake called "roller coaster." But those who got on it all screamed loudly. I'm curious about it. Next time, I'm gonna sit right next to you and observe your expressions closely.
I forgot to give you the "furry buddy." To remind you to play with me more, I collected the hair that fell off from my tail and made it into this little guy. "Furry buddy" smells like me. Remember this smell, and you will be able to find me no matter where I go in the future.
I love to play with the "furry buddy." Don't forget to bring it with you next time.

Title: Activation Date is Celebration Day
Content:
The mission at the conservation area this time is a bit boring. How do I put it? It's like the kind of mission that just requires two hours of you time every day.
I have to say I hate this dull vibe before the Activation Date.
The good news is that I get to take a break from work. And the residents here are preparing an outdoor celebration day. I heard there would be special foods like taiyaki and yakisoba pan and fireworks at the end. And I feel super lucky because that day happens to be my Activation Date.
If you're free recently, we could meet here. After all, it would be frustrating to spend the Activation Date alone.
I will be wearing my yukata, and I hope Commandant can wear something that matches it. This isn't too much to ask, right?

Title: No More Rain, Please
Content:
It's a pity that it had been raining throughout the celebration day. All the outdoor activities were ruined, the wet taiyaki was not even worth a try, and the fireworks were cancelled.
The Activation Date was full of regrets... However, hanging around with you was fun. Do you feel the same, Commandant?
Especially the shinai duel we had through the afternoon, which I think is the highlight of the day. After all, it is one of the few indoor activities I find interesting. Thank you for accepting my "why not we do some shinai training"" proposal. Don't tell me that you find this repetitive sport dull (chuckle).
Do you have sore muscles after the training, Commandant? If so, just take a hot shower when you're back.
It's still raining here. I hope the weather would be better when we meet next time.
To fulfill this wish, I made you an interesting trinket. I looks a bit rough, but just try to pray for a sunny day the next day. Perhaps it would work... Remember to be sincere, Commandant.
It's time for my night long-distance running training. I'll save my words for the next time we meet.
Remember to pray to the ""teru teru bozu" before we meet next time.

Title: A battle with your soul on the line! Dare you come?
Content:
Dear User,
The Siren's Secret Room scripted mystery game is now open for registration!
"The whole crew is ready. Let's raise the ship's mast and set sail for the uncharted sea! Meanwhile, the siren is sculpting her new puppet... Will she bless or punish these uninvited human guests? Who would win this battle with everybody's soul on the line?""
Based on the location you authorized, we have found you evenly-matched opponents nearby.
Sign up now to join the game at 13:00. Dare you come?
Thank you for your support. Reply STOP to unsubscribe.

----------------Drafts----------------
Hi there, I'm the ""Miss L" who booked the game yesterday. Would it be fine if I bring one more person to the Siren's Secret Room Activation Date Discount Session at 13:00? O-one free character would be fine. After all, I'm not sure if that person would come or not... But I'll try my best to convince that person! Just save one more slot for me, please!

Title: I Was Wrong
Content:
I apologize. I admit that I'm bad at this.
Waaait... Don't send STOP just yet! I'll tell you everything! The ad mail was from me! I-I just wanted t-to see if you dare to play that game with me...
Here is a review of the game we just played, including the records of your "highlight moments"" and my sincere apology to you.
I'm extremely impressed by your performance. I can't believe you managed to twist the story before the strict siren, redeem all the punished crew's vessels, turn things around at the critical moment, and win her ""soul puppet""... I... You... did a fantastic job.
By the way, I promise to accept the honorable Commandant's requirements of the game without any conditions. I promise to never hide the script and to comply with the rules. No more takebacks, or taking out frustration on the chess pieces, or overturning the chess board! In the name of the sea!
...
...So... are you still willing to play scripted mystery games with me again in the future? I just wanted to redeem my ""soul puppet." Nothing else. Believe me.

Title: Let's go!
Content:
Commandant,
Time to go! Or we'll miss the visit slot we booked!
Actually, the early Golden Age space stations are only here on exhibition because they have been decommissioned. The Technicians Union will start to demolish them later. Although most of the parts and structures are not compatible with the devices now, the demolishing process is a great chance to communicate with the engineers in the past across temporal and spatial dimensions. After all, many design ideas are not kept in the blueprints or the documents.
Anyway, I want to have a look at them before the exhibition ends. You know it would be super lonely... No, boring! Boring, I mean, to do it alone! Plus, last time no body explained the thoughts behind the designs to you, right?
Besides, it's not bad to observe the universe beyond the stars...
Damn... That was a bit off the topic! Anyways, we are running out of time. I'll meet you downstairs at your dormitory. See you later!

Title: Dammit!
Content:
Damn it...
I didn't notice your visit application, Commandant! It wasn't a good idea to leave the present there!
Anyway, I know you specially prepared it for me, but if I had demolished things faster, it would have been ruined!
Um, I'm not saying I don't like it! After all, this guitar effect pedal is kinda rare...
I didn't expect see so many old stuff there. The WGAA guys must be interested into those old dashboards and the supply boxes... The attachment is a cassette I found in one of the gift boxes. The cosmic radiation has damaged the magnetic powder, so the sound quality is a bit affected. Remember to listen to it with the walkman I gave you.
I-I just want to check if it still works! I recorded some melodies with the effect pedal on Side B and—you just have to listen to them!
Remember to put on your earphones. And don't share the music with others!
Never!
